title: Fluidstack signs 25-year, 168 MW lease with TeraWulf's Abernathy JV (~$9.5B)

sources.quote: The 25-year hosting commitment represents approximately $9.5 billion in contracted revenue to the joint venture.

explain: Fluidstack committed to 25 years of rent for 168 megawatts at a new campus in Abernathy, Texas, owned by a joint venture that was 51% TeraWulf and 49% Fluidstack. In July 2026 TeraWulf agreed to sell its stake in that venture to a Fluidstack-led group.
